# France Rework - scripted effects for the Franc and Free France (generated by build_systems.py)

FRW_inflation_update = {
	clamp_variable = { var = FRW_inflation min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { FRW_inf_p = FRW_inflation }
	subtract_from_variable = { FRW_inf_p = 20 }
	clamp_variable = { var = FRW_inf_p min = 0 max = 80 }
	set_variable = { FRW_inf_cg = FRW_inf_p }
	multiply_variable = { FRW_inf_cg = 0.0015 }
	set_variable = { FRW_inf_stab = FRW_inf_p }
	multiply_variable = { FRW_inf_stab = -0.0015 }
	set_variable = { FRW_inf_build = 20 }
	subtract_from_variable = { FRW_inf_build = FRW_inflation }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { FRW_inf_build > 0 } } multiply_variable = { FRW_inf_build = 0.002 } }
	else = { multiply_variable = { FRW_inf_build = 0.001 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = FRW_franc } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = FRW_franc } }
	clamp_variable = { var = FRW_gold min = 0 max = 4000 }
	FRW_inflation_trend = yes
}

# monthly change of inflation and gold - recomputed after every change, so the menu is always current
FRW_inflation_trend = {
	set_variable = { FRW_inf_trend = 0 }
		if = { limit = { always = yes } add_to_variable = { FRW_inf_trend = -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_war = yes } add_to_variable = { FRW_inf_trend = 2.0 } }
		if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = FRW_econ_rearmament } add_to_variable = { FRW_inf_trend = 1.0 } }
		if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = FRW_econ_dirigisme } add_to_variable = { FRW_inf_trend = 0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = FRW_econ_liberal } add_to_variable = { FRW_inf_trend = -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = FRW_paid_holidays } add_to_variable = { FRW_inf_trend = 0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = FRW_strike_wave } add_to_variable = { FRW_inf_trend = 0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = war_economy } add_to_variable = { FRW_inf_trend = 0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = tot_economic_mobilisation } add_to_variable = { FRW_inf_trend = 1.0 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = FRW_banque_reformed } add_to_variable = { FRW_inf_trend = -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = FRW_tripartite_done } add_to_variable = { FRW_inf_trend = -0.25 } }
		if = { limit = { has_stability < 0.3 } add_to_variable = { FRW_inf_trend = 0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_government = communism } add_to_variable = { FRW_inf_trend = -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = FRW_cfa_zone } add_to_variable = { FRW_inf_trend = -0.25 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { FRW_inflation > 75 } } add_to_variable = { FRW_inf_trend = 0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { FRW_gold > 1999 } } add_to_variable = { FRW_inf_trend = -0.25 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { FRW_gold < 1000 } check_variable = { FRW_gold > 399 } } add_to_variable = { FRW_inf_trend = 0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { FRW_gold < 400 } } add_to_variable = { FRW_inf_trend = 1.0 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = FRW_fiscal_reform } add_to_variable = { FRW_inf_trend = -0.25 } }
	set_variable = { FRW_gold_trend = 0 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = FRW_popular_front NOT = { has_country_flag = FRW_exchange_controls } } add_to_variable = { FRW_gold_trend = -20 } }
		if = { limit = { has_government = communism NOT = { has_country_flag = FRW_exchange_controls } } add_to_variable = { FRW_gold_trend = -30 } }
		if = { limit = { has_stability < 0.3 NOT = { has_country_flag = FRW_exchange_controls } } add_to_variable = { FRW_gold_trend = -15 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { FRW_inflation > 50 } } add_to_variable = { FRW_gold_trend = -15 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { FRW_inflation < 20 } } add_to_variable = { FRW_gold_trend = 10 } }
		if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = FRW_econ_liberal } add_to_variable = { FRW_gold_trend = 10 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = FRW_tripartite_done } add_to_variable = { FRW_gold_trend = 5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = FRW_cfa_zone } add_to_variable = { FRW_gold_trend = 5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_war = yes } add_to_variable = { FRW_gold_trend = -15 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = FRW_gold_loan } add_to_variable = { FRW_gold_trend = -10 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = FRW_stab_fund } add_to_variable = { FRW_gold_trend = 5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = FRW_colonial_gold } add_to_variable = { FRW_gold_trend = 5 } }
}

FRW_inflation_monthly = {
	FRW_inflation_trend = yes
	add_to_variable = { FRW_inflation = FRW_inf_trend }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_gold = FRW_gold_trend }
	FRW_inflation_update = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { FRW_gold < 500 } NOT = { has_country_flag = FRW_gold_low_warned } }
		set_country_flag = FRW_gold_low_warned
		country_event = { id = frw_sys.5 days = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { FRW_gold > 999 } has_country_flag = FRW_gold_low_warned }
		clr_country_flag = FRW_gold_low_warned
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { FRW_inflation > 59 } NOT = { has_country_flag = FRW_inf_crisis_warned } }
		set_country_flag = FRW_inf_crisis_warned
		country_event = { id = frw_sys.1 days = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { FRW_inflation < 40 } has_country_flag = FRW_inf_crisis_warned }
		clr_country_flag = FRW_inf_crisis_warned
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { FRW_inflation > 84 } NOT = { has_country_flag = FRW_inf_hyper_warned } }
		set_country_flag = FRW_inf_hyper_warned
		country_event = { id = frw_sys.3 days = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { FRW_inflation < 60 } has_country_flag = FRW_inf_hyper_warned }
		clr_country_flag = FRW_inf_hyper_warned
	}
}

# ---------------- Free France ----------------
FRW_ff_update = {
	clamp_variable = { var = FRW_ff_prestige min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { FRW_ffc_eq = FRW_ff_prestige }
	multiply_variable = { FRW_ffc_eq = 0.5 }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffc_eq = 45 }
	set_temp_variable = { t = FRW_fff_eq }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = t min = 0 max = 3 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { t = 10 }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffc_eq = t }

	clamp_variable = { var = FRW_ffc_eq min = 5 max = 90 }
	set_variable = { FRW_ffe_eq = FRW_ffc_eq }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffe_eq = 25 }
	if = { limit = { ENG = { exists = yes has_war_with = GER has_capitulated = no } } add_to_variable = { FRW_ffe_eq = 10 } }
	clamp_variable = { var = FRW_ffe_eq min = 5 max = 95 }
	set_variable = { FRW_ffc_aof = FRW_ff_prestige }
	multiply_variable = { FRW_ffc_aof = 0.5 }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffc_aof = 10 }
	set_temp_variable = { t = FRW_fff_aof }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = t min = 0 max = 3 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { t = 10 }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffc_aof = t }
		if = { limit = { controls_state = 774 } add_to_variable = { FRW_ffc_aof = 10 } }
	clamp_variable = { var = FRW_ffc_aof min = 5 max = 90 }
	set_variable = { FRW_ffe_aof = FRW_ffc_aof }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffe_aof = 25 }
	if = { limit = { ENG = { exists = yes has_war_with = GER has_capitulated = no } } add_to_variable = { FRW_ffe_aof = 10 } }
	clamp_variable = { var = FRW_ffe_aof min = 5 max = 95 }
	set_variable = { FRW_ffc_afn = FRW_ff_prestige }
	multiply_variable = { FRW_ffc_afn = 0.5 }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffc_afn = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { t = FRW_fff_afn }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = t min = 0 max = 3 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { t = 10 }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffc_afn = t }
		if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = FRW_leclerc_column } add_to_variable = { FRW_ffc_afn = 10 } }
		if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = FRW_army_of_africa_marches } add_to_variable = { FRW_ffc_afn = 10 } }
	clamp_variable = { var = FRW_ffc_afn min = 5 max = 90 }
	set_variable = { FRW_ffe_afn = FRW_ffc_afn }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffe_afn = 25 }
	if = { limit = { ENG = { exists = yes has_war_with = GER has_capitulated = no } } add_to_variable = { FRW_ffe_afn = 10 } }
	clamp_variable = { var = FRW_ffe_afn min = 5 max = 95 }
	set_variable = { FRW_ffc_lev = FRW_ff_prestige }
	multiply_variable = { FRW_ffc_lev = 0.5 }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffc_lev = 5 }
	set_temp_variable = { t = FRW_fff_lev }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = t min = 0 max = 3 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { t = 10 }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffc_lev = t }
		if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = FRW_free_french_forces } add_to_variable = { FRW_ffc_lev = 10 } }
	clamp_variable = { var = FRW_ffc_lev min = 5 max = 90 }
	set_variable = { FRW_ffe_lev = FRW_ffc_lev }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffe_lev = 25 }
	if = { limit = { ENG = { exists = yes has_war_with = GER has_capitulated = no } } add_to_variable = { FRW_ffe_lev = 10 } }
	clamp_variable = { var = FRW_ffe_lev min = 5 max = 95 }
	set_variable = { FRW_ffc_mad = FRW_ff_prestige }
	multiply_variable = { FRW_ffc_mad = 0.5 }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffc_mad = 15 }
	set_temp_variable = { t = FRW_fff_mad }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = t min = 0 max = 3 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { t = 10 }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffc_mad = t }
		if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = FRW_brazzaville_conference } add_to_variable = { FRW_ffc_mad = 10 } }
	clamp_variable = { var = FRW_ffc_mad min = 5 max = 90 }
	set_variable = { FRW_ffe_mad = FRW_ffc_mad }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffe_mad = 25 }
	if = { limit = { ENG = { exists = yes has_war_with = GER has_capitulated = no } } add_to_variable = { FRW_ffe_mad = 10 } }
	clamp_variable = { var = FRW_ffe_mad min = 5 max = 95 }
	set_variable = { FRW_ffc_dji = FRW_ff_prestige }
	multiply_variable = { FRW_ffc_dji = 0.5 }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffc_dji = 15 }
	set_temp_variable = { t = FRW_fff_dji }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = t min = 0 max = 3 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { t = 10 }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffc_dji = t }

	clamp_variable = { var = FRW_ffc_dji min = 5 max = 90 }
	set_variable = { FRW_ffe_dji = FRW_ffc_dji }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffe_dji = 25 }
	if = { limit = { ENG = { exists = yes has_war_with = GER has_capitulated = no } } add_to_variable = { FRW_ffe_dji = 10 } }
	clamp_variable = { var = FRW_ffe_dji min = 5 max = 95 }
	set_variable = { FRW_ffc_ind = FRW_ff_prestige }
	multiply_variable = { FRW_ffc_ind = 0.5 }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffc_ind = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { t = FRW_fff_ind }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = t min = 0 max = 3 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { t = 10 }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffc_ind = t }
		if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = FRW_brazzaville_conference } add_to_variable = { FRW_ffc_ind = 10 } }
	clamp_variable = { var = FRW_ffc_ind min = 5 max = 90 }
	set_variable = { FRW_ffe_ind = FRW_ffc_ind }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ffe_ind = 25 }
	if = { limit = { ENG = { exists = yes has_war_with = GER has_capitulated = no } } add_to_variable = { FRW_ffe_ind = 10 } }
	clamp_variable = { var = FRW_ffe_ind min = 5 max = 95 }
	set_variable = { FRW_ffp_pp = FRW_ff_prestige }
	multiply_variable = { FRW_ffp_pp = 0.002 }
	set_variable = { FRW_ffp_mp = FRW_ff_prestige }
	multiply_variable = { FRW_ffp_mp = 0.0005 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = FRW_ff_prestige_mod } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = FRW_ff_prestige_mod } }
}

FRW_ff_monthly = {
	set_temp_variable = { g = 1 }
	if = { limit = { any_allied_country = { is_major = yes has_capitulated = no } } add_to_temp_variable = { g = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { FRW_ff_prestige > 60 } } multiply_temp_variable = { g = 0.5 } }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ff_prestige = g }
	FRW_ff_update = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { FRW_ff_prestige > 49 } NOT = { has_country_flag = FRW_ff_m50 } }
		set_country_flag = FRW_ff_m50
		country_event = { id = frw_sys.50 days = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { FRW_ff_prestige > 79 } NOT = { has_country_flag = FRW_ff_m80 } }
		set_country_flag = FRW_ff_m80
		country_event = { id = frw_sys.51 days = 1 }
	}
}

FRW_gold_check = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_capitulated = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = FRW_war_gold_done } NOT = { has_country_flag = FRW_gold_lost } check_variable = { FRW_gold > 0 } }
		set_country_flag = FRW_gold_lost
		set_variable = { FRW_gold = 0 }
		country_event = { id = frw_sys.4 days = 1 }
	}
}

FRW_ff_start = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = FRW_ff_prestige } }
		set_variable = { FRW_ff_prestige = 20 }
	}
	FRW_ff_update = yes
}

FRW_ff_set_capital = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { capital_scope = { is_controlled_by = ROOT } }
				capital_scope = { NOT = { is_on_continent = europe } NOT = { is_on_continent = africa } }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { controls_state = 772 } set_capital = { state = 772 } }
		else_if = { limit = { controls_state = 459 } set_capital = { state = 459 } }
		else_if = { limit = { controls_state = 272 } set_capital = { state = 272 } }
	}
}

FRW_ff_join_eq = {
	every_state = {
		limit = { OR = { state = 772 state = 773 state = 774 state = 775 state = 539 } owner = { FRW_is_vichy = yes } }
		ROOT = { transfer_state = PREV }
	}
	add_manpower = 10000
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = 1000 }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ff_prestige = 5 }
	set_country_flag = FRW_ff_rallied_eq
	FRW_ff_set_capital = yes
	every_country = { limit = { FRW_is_vichy = yes } country_event = { id = frw_sys.40 } }
}

FRW_ff_rally_eq = {
	clr_country_flag = FRW_ff_busy_eq
	set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = roll min = 0 max = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { roll < FRW_ffc_eq } FRW_vichy_holds_eq = yes }
		FRW_ff_join_eq = yes
		country_event = { id = frw_sys.20 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { FRW_vichy_holds_eq = yes }
		add_to_variable = { FRW_ff_prestige = -5 }
		add_to_variable = { FRW_fff_eq = 1 }
		country_event = { id = frw_sys.30 }
	}
	FRW_ff_update = yes
}

FRW_ff_exped_eq = {
	clr_country_flag = FRW_ff_busy_eq
	set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = roll min = 0 max = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { roll < FRW_ffe_eq } FRW_vichy_holds_eq = yes }
		FRW_ff_join_eq = yes
		army_experience = 10
		country_event = { id = frw_sys.60 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { FRW_vichy_holds_eq = yes }
		add_to_variable = { FRW_ff_prestige = -8 }
		add_to_variable = { FRW_fff_eq = 1 }
		country_event = { id = frw_sys.70 }
	}
	FRW_ff_update = yes
}

		ROOT = { transfer_state = PREV }

FRW_ff_join_lev = {
	every_state = {
		limit = { is_on_continent = middle_east owner = { FRW_is_vichy = yes } }

	add_manpower = 15000
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = 1500 }

FRW_ff_exped_lev = {
	clr_country_flag = FRW_ff_busy_lev
	set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = roll min = 0 max = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { roll < FRW_ffe_lev } FRW_vichy_holds_lev = yes }
		FRW_ff_join_lev = yes
		army_experience = 10
		country_event = { id = frw_sys.63 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { FRW_vichy_holds_lev = yes }
		add_to_variable = { FRW_ff_prestige = -8 }
		add_to_variable = { FRW_fff_lev = 1 }
		country_event = { id = frw_sys.73 }
	}
	FRW_ff_update = yes
}

FRW_ff_join_mad = {
	every_state = {
		limit = { OR = { state = 543 state = 706 state = 708 state = 713 } owner = { FRW_is_vichy = yes } }
		ROOT = { transfer_state = PREV }
	}
	add_manpower = 15000
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = 1000 }
	add_to_variable = { FRW_ff_prestige = 5 }
	set_country_flag = FRW_ff_rallied_mad
	FRW_ff_set_capital = yes
	every_country = { limit = { FRW_is_vichy = yes } country_event = { id = frw_sys.40 } }
